title: Add fail-closed original-marketplace evidence ingest
guarantees: Evidence application is dry-run by default and rejects any mismatch in task identity, sale date, price, marketplace or serial.
A direct marketplace URL must match the stored marketplace host, or a stable original sale identifier must be supplied.
Rejected evidence leaves the market record unchanged and successful verification never changes realized sale prices.
The generated market-verification queue derives contribution verification directly from supporting market-record sales.
